query: SELECT jsonb_build_object('source_pages',(SELECT count(*) FROM public.source_pages s JOIN public.books b ON b.id=s.book_id WHERE b.title='Jubayer''s GK' AND s.source_page BETWEEN 749 AND 753),'topics',(SELECT count(*) FROM public.topics t JOIN public.chapters c ON c.id=t.chapter_id JOIN public.books b ON b.id=c.book_id WHERE b.title='Jubayer''s GK' AND c.slug='europe' AND t.slug IN ('un-examination-boundary-749','oic-boundary-750','arab-league-asem-boundary-751','nam-imctc-boundary-752','commonwealth-boundary-753')),'facts',(SELECT count(*) FROM public.gk_facts WHERE source_page BETWEEN 749 AND 753),'notes',(SELECT count(*) FROM public.gk_notes WHERE source_page BETWEEN 749 AND 753),'mcqs',(SELECT count(*) FROM public.gk_mcqs WHERE source_page BETWEEN 749 AND 753),'mcq_options',(SELECT count(*) FROM public.gk_mcq_options o JOIN public.gk_mcqs m ON m.id=o.mcq_id WHERE m.source_page BETWEEN 749 AND 753),'verifications',(SELECT count(*) FROM public.fact_verifications WHERE source_page BETWEEN 749 AND 753),'flashcards',(SELECT count(*) FROM public.flashcards WHERE source_key LIKE 'batch0749-0753:%'),'search_documents',0) AS batch_integrity LIMIT 1;
